#  35454 - Nuclear Power Plants Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **35454 - module is no longer offered from SS 2012**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Nuclear Power Plants**  |  
|  Kernkraftwerke   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 3 - Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering and Industrial Engineering   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Dr.-Ing. Kleen, Uwe 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every winter semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Students will get an overview of safety requironments and consequential design principles and the management of operations and Lifetime of nuclear power plants  |  
| Contents:  | Physical basics of nuclear power, safety requirements and principles, operations and lifetime management, new NPPs  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | basic understanding of power plants, physicalbasics und nuclear power plant production  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Exercise / 3 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 165 Hours
